name: Distro 10 - Edible Gummies 200mg - Razz Magic
description:
Big flavor in a small bite. Distro 10 Razz Magic gummies deliver bold blue raspberry taste — sweet, tangy, and candy-shop nostalgic in every piece.

Each pack contains 10 gummies at 20mg each — 200mg total — so it's easy to dial in exactly the dose you want. Perfectly soft, perfectly sweet, and ready whenever you are.

10 gummies × 20mg — 200mg per pack
Bold Razz Magic flavor — sweet, tangy blue raspberry
Easy to portion — consistent dosing in every piece

Start low, go slow, and enjoy the ride.

For adult use only. Must be 21+. Keep out of reach of children and pets.
